description: Forming the flexible strap of a clasp by threading several thin leather strips through the fitting's ring, pasting each strip's ends together, then braiding the doubled strips into a plait. The finished end is led through a hole near the board edge and glued down inside, often into a cut groove so it lies flush.
name: plaiting clasp straps
